name: Patrick Not My Wallet
look: Eight panels, four rows of two, from SpongeBob SquarePants in a dark blue cave. A blue-gloved hand holds up Patrick Star's ID card, Man Ray shows the card to a smiling Patrick, then holds up a wallet and crouches to hand it to Patrick, who stands beside him.
use: Man Ray shows Patrick his own ID found in a wallet. Patrick agrees the ID is his but insists the wallet isn't. Used for someone who accepts every piece of evidence yet still denies the obvious conclusion.
slots: Man Ray shows the first piece of evidence
Man Ray shows the next piece of evidence
Man Ray states the obvious conclusion
examples: And this 5 AM alarm is on your phone?
So you set the 5 AM alarm.
I would never set a 5 AM alarm.
